channel.title: The Mutapa Times — Daily Zimbabwe Weather + Tsumo
channel.description: Daily weather forecast for Zimbabwe's main cities plus the Tsumo yezuva (proverb of the day). One item per day, dedicated for the Mutapa Times weather autolist.

item.title: Zim weather 19 Oct: Harare mainly clear · high 32° / low 18°
item.description: Harare: high 32°, low 18° (mainly clear) · Bulawayo: high 34°, low 19° (partly cloudy) · Mutare: high 33°, low 17° (partly cloudy) · Gweru: high 33°, low 18° (partly cloudy) · Masvingo: high 35°, low 20° (partly cloudy) · Victoria Falls: high 39°, low 23° (partly cloudy) Tsumo yezuva: Mbudzi kuzvarira pavanhu kuda kutandirwa imbwa.
